reasoning: B wins, narrowly. Both attempts handle the core task correctly: they use Vide springs created in component bodies, slide the panel off by its Position, drive the slide from `present` with a removal delay, and compute the highlight glide from tile size and gap in offset units. A disables interaction more reliably because it sets Interactable on each button, and it adds hover feedback. But it fails StyLua on a line it changed, which is a real defect that blocks merging. B passes every check. Its only weak spot is that setting Interactable on the panel frame may not disable the buttons inside it during the brief slide out, and the panel is still visible while that happens. Passing every check tips it toward B.

criteria.note: The `scale`, `highlightPosition` and `panelPosition` springs are created in the `tile`/`blockPicker` bodies and bound to `Scale` and `Position`, with nothing created inside bindings.

criteria.criterion: Closing slide plays / opens by moving panel
criteria.note: `blockPicker` returns `(panel, EXIT_DURATION)` straight through the `show` builder, its slide is driven by `present` via `Shown`, and it moves the panel's `Position` to an offset fully below the screen.
`show` reuses the same instance when reopened mid-slide, so the spring reverses, and `Interactable = props.Interactable` on every button stops a closing picker from taking clicks.
`tileOffset(index)` uses `(index-1)*(TILE_SIZE+TILE_GAP)` inside the padded panel, so no AbsolutePosition is read.
`InputBegan`/`InputEnded` filter MouseButton1 and Touch to drive a UIScale spring, `MouseLeave` resets the press, and it adds a hover scale on top.
The logic is sound, but StyLua fails on its own long `Size = UDim2.fromOffset(...)` line.
The `scale`, `position` and `highlightPosition` springs are created in the `tile`/`panel` bodies, with the scale read inside a `Size` binding.

criteria.criterion: Closing slide plays / opens by moving panel
criteria.note: The builder returns `panel(...), SLIDE_OUT_SECONDS` inside `show`, slides on `present`, and its critically damped 0.3s spring is off screen well within 0.4s.
Reopening reverses the same panel, but `Interactable = props.IsOpen` is set only on the panel Frame, which may not block clicks on the child TextButtons during the slide out.
`tilePosition(index)` computes the position from TILE_SIZE and TILE_GAP inside the padding.
`InputBegan`/`InputEnded` handle MouseButton1 and Touch (plus gamepad and Return), `MouseLeave` resets, and a bouncy spring returns the tile to rest.
All checks pass and selection, placement, and the Build button are kept; the added `Vide.strict = IsStudio()` is harmless.

Highlight is hidden if the selected name isn't in the list
Hover and press feedback through a UIScale spring
weaknesses: StyLua check fails on a line it changed
Changes the BlockPicker signature to return two values, which is a slightly implicit contract
